preset.title: Preset
preset.description: A ready-made policy: keys_never (every credential kind must ask before sending), client_names (configured client and matter words/formats must ask), clinic (patient and staff identifiers must ask), or tax_office (Social Security, tax ID, bank and birth-date details must ask; configured client names/formats must ask). Client names and formats must be added by the organization; the preset does not know them by itself. Your other settings are added on top; an explicit requiredResponses entry beats the preset's.

orgName.title: Organization name
orgName.description: Shown to your people in Clotr and on the printed policy page. Up to 80 characters.

requiredResponses.title: Required responses
requiredResponses.description: Kinds of data (as in patterns.js, e.g. aws_access_key) and how Clotr must respond: block (ask before sending), warn or log. A floor, never a ceiling: a person may still choose a stricter response than this for themselves.

watchWords.title: Watch words
watchWords.description: Words or phrases (up to 4 words each) added to the Watch List, e.g. project code names. Their response follows requiredResponses.watch_list; set it to warn or block to require at least a warning or ask-before-sending. Without that floor, a person's Watch List response may be quieter. A format with # for a digit and @ for a letter (at least 4 marks, no digits, for example EMP-#####) is watched as a format instead. Together with the words and formats in kinds: 500 words and 50 formats in all. Browser/OS management receives these values and may retain them in its policy source and on managed computers. Clotr fingerprints literal words locally before matching and does not write original words to its own settings/vault; this is not encryption of the managed policy. Formats are used as configured.

lockSettings.title: Lock settings
lockSettings.description: People can see but not change Clotr's settings or vault.

holdFiles.title: Hold files
holdFiles.description: An attached file waits for the person to answer about anything Clotr finds inside it, not just a kind set to block. On by default once this policy sets anything else; set to false to only hold a file for a kind set to block, the same as for someone with no policy at all.

kinds.title: Your own kinds
kinds.description: Up to 20 kinds of detail your organization names itself, for example a matter number or a client name. Clotr warns about each one by its name and, with Bandage on, swaps it for its cover word, like [Matter 1]. Words and formats are shared with watchWords: 500 words and 50 formats in all. Literal values are present in browser/OS management policy; Clotr fingerprints words locally before matching, but does not encrypt or hide the policy values from the organization's policy administrators.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in warnings, the local policy page and the optional training page, up to 40 characters, e.g. Matter number. This label is in management policy and may be visible to policy administrators; use a general label, not a real client name.

words.title: Words
words.description: Words or phrases of this kind (up to 4 words each), e.g. client names. Present in browser/OS management policy; Clotr fingerprints locally before matching, but the original values are not encrypted from policy administrators.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: Formats of this kind: # for a digit, @ for a letter, at least 4 marks, no digits, up to 40 characters, e.g. MAT-######.

near.title: Nearby words
near.description: Optional, up to 10: a format counts only when one of these words is within 40 characters before it, e.g. matter or file.

response.title: Response
response.description: How Clotr must respond: block (ask before sending), warn or log. A floor, never a ceiling. Warn if not set.

cover.title: Cover word
cover.description: Bandage's word for it, up to 20 characters, no digits or brackets: Matter gives [Matter 1]. The name if not set.
